description: This file defines functions for creating and managing MCP tool runtime environments, including materializing tools, generating agent results, and creating runtime instances for MCP tools.

methods.name: toAgentToolResult
methods.description: Converts a CallToolResult into an AgentToolResult, formatting content and details appropriately.

methods.name: materializeBundleMcpToolsForRun
methods.description: Creates a runtime environment with MCP tools, normalizing names, and preparing execute functions for each tool.

methods.name: createBundleMcpToolRuntime
methods.description: Creates a session runtime and materializes MCP tools for use.
